workflow: A second production invocation serializes the named page setup/template independently, compares it byte-for-byte with the Chromium download, imports it into a fresh document, serializes KDRAW1 and validates its manifest checksum on reopen.
result: Template bytes were deterministic and identical, a consistent plot-style mutation changed the hash, dangling and stale named-setup references were rejected, KDRAW1 checksum read-back passed, existing geometry was preserved and the imported layout contained no entities.
